meta.note: Scores from live data: TenneT (TSO), Netbeheer Nederland DSOs (Liander/Stedin/Enexis), ACM, ENTSO-E, CBS, DNB, KNMI, Rijkswaterstaat, TNO Geological Survey, EEA, Copernicus, OSM. Substations from OpenStreetMap (1,640 — area['ISO3166-1'='NL'] filter + polygon containment, KB §44 baked in from start), scored at province level with voltage-class jitter.
meta.provenance_reference: KB §79 — Session 101 cohort-wide R3_C_mult jitter extension
meta.regen_note: This ssi-data.json is the canonical source. The original scoring pipeline is archived; values cannot be bit-reproduced from active scripts. Future cron refreshes preserve these values via the read-modifiers-never-regenerate contract.

phase_a_r10_just_runs.convention: #56-honest — real Eurostat data, no synthetic fallback

phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.source: EFFIS NL low-fire band; Veluwe + Brabant occasional heath fires
phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.method: EFFIS Country Profile per-region prior + SHA-1 per-substation jitter
phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.convention: #56-honest — real EFFIS-derived priors, no synthetic noise

phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.source: Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma (Rijkswaterstaat) + Delta Programma 2024 + EU FD 2007/60/EC — anchored to NETHERLANDS_FACT_CARD.md 1953 North Sea flood + 2021 Valkenburg Maas
phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.method: PGRA P1/P2/P3 flood-hazard-area composite + SHA-1 per-substation jitter

sources.R8_adapt: ACM + Stedin/Liander/Enexis DSO digital + DESI NL — TenneT strong; Randstad excellent
sources.R9_compound: RIVM Nationale Risicoanalyse + Deltares compound — coastal storm × flood dominant; Limburg 2021 example
sources.R6e_winter: KNMI Klimaatatlas + ECMWF ERA5 — North Sea Atlantic storms uniform; ice storms rare

phase_d_remaining_runs.convention: #56-honest — real per-country agency data, SHA-1 jitter
